answer.reason: Both deliver clinical care paid by insurers and government payers. Pediatrix sells physician services (neonatal, maternal-fetal, pediatric) under partnerships with hospitals. UHS owns and operates acute care and behavioral health hospitals and other facilities. The care and patient base overlap only partly, and the business models differ: staffing partner versus facility operator.
